title: China-to-Brazil Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety and INMETRO Compulsory Certification
rows.target_requirement: Certain portable electric power tools fall under INMETRO compulsory conformity assessment set by a specific Portaria, with safety testing to the ABNT NBR IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and lawn-and-garden tools. Certification is issued by an accredited certification body (OCP), and the tool must be designed for the Brazilian 127/220 V, 60 Hz grid rather than China's 220/380 V, 50 Hz. Chargers, external power supplies, and adapters need their own safety basis under the applicable ABNT NBR standard.
target_standards: INMETRO compulsory certification Portaria for portable electric tools (applicable Portaria for the specific tool family)
ABNT NBR IEC 62841 series (general and particular requirements for hand-held, transportable, and lawn-and-garden motor-operated tools)
Conformity certificate issued by an INMETRO-accredited certification body (OCP)
ABNT NBR charger or external power-supply safety standard where applicable
rows.china_equivalent: China files commonly use the GB/T 3883 series for tool safety, with CCC certification where the product family is listed, plus separate charger evidence where applicable. These are a China domestic baseline and must be mapped onto Brazilian ABNT NBR IEC 62841 testing and an OCP certificate rather than treated as automatic INMETRO acceptance.
china_standards: CCC certification where the tool family is listed
China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: The main gap is that China GB/T or CCC evidence is not recognised by INMETRO. A Chinese exporter must obtain a fresh ABNT NBR IEC 62841 test report and an OCP certificate, confirm the tool and charger work on 127/220 V 60 Hz, and have an in-country importer manage the certification and INMETRO seal. Reusing a 220 V 50 Hz design without re-rating for the Brazilian grid is a common failure.

target.en: Mandatory: where the tool family is listed under an INMETRO compulsory certification Portaria, conformity certification through an accredited OCP using the ABNT NBR IEC 62841 series is a legal market-access condition, and the INMETRO conformity seal must be displayed.
target.zh: 强制：当工具类别列入 INMETRO 强制认证 Portaria 时，经认可 OCP 依 ABNT NBR IEC 62841 系列完成符合性认证是法定市场准入条件，且须加贴 INMETRO 符合性标识。
target.zht: 強制：當工具類別列入 INMETRO 強制認證 Portaria 時，經認可 OCP 依 ABNT NBR IEC 62841 系列完成符合性認證是法定市場准入條件，且須加貼 INMETRO 符合性標識。

cn.en: China domestic baseline uses GB/T 3883 series and CCC where the family is listed; this does not satisfy INMETRO certification.
cn.zh: 中国国内基线采用 GB/T 3883 系列，类别列入时附 CCC；这不满足 INMETRO 认证。
cn.zht: 中國國內基線採用 GB/T 3883 系列，類別列入時附 CCC；這不滿足 INMETRO 認證。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Brazil-ready until the tool family is checked against the applicable INMETRO Portaria and, where compulsory, certified by an accredited OCP under the ABNT NBR IEC 62841 series with the design rated for 127/220 V 60 Hz; China GB/T or CCC evidence does not substitute for INMETRO certification.

source.publisher: INMETRO (Instituto Nacional de Metrologia, Qualidade e Tecnologia)

rows.requirement: EMC and ANATEL Homologation for Cordless Radio
rows.target_requirement: Electromagnetic compatibility for power tools in Brazil is addressed through the ABNT NBR IEC 62841 EMC requirements and INMETRO conformity assessment. Any cordless tool that contains a radio module, such as Bluetooth connectivity or a wireless control link, additionally requires ANATEL homologation as telecommunications and radio equipment before it can be lawfully marketed.
target_standards: ABNT NBR IEC 62841 series EMC requirements within INMETRO conformity assessment
ANATEL homologation (Resolution-based certification for telecommunications and radio products) for any embedded radio module
ANATEL Act of homologation and identification label requirements
rows.china_equivalent: China files often rely on GB/T 3883 series with GB EMC limits and, for radio modules, the SRRC type approval used domestically. These do not transfer to Brazil, where EMC sits inside the INMETRO and ABNT route and radio approval is a separate ANATEL homologation.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series with applicable GB EMC limits
SRRC type approval for radio modules used domestically in China
rows.gap: A cordless tool with a wireless feature faces two distinct Brazilian approvals: EMC handled inside the INMETRO and ABNT NBR IEC 62841 process, and a separate ANATEL homologation for the radio module with its own label and Act number. China SRRC approval is not recognised, and shipping a connected tool without ANATEL homologation is a common compliance gap.

target.en: Mandatory: EMC compliance forms part of the INMETRO and ABNT NBR IEC 62841 conformity assessment, and ANATEL homologation is a legal precondition for any cordless tool containing a radio module before it is placed on the Brazilian market.
target.zh: 强制：EMC 符合性构成 INMETRO 与 ABNT NBR IEC 62841 符合性评定的一部分，而任何含无线电模块的无绳工具投放巴西市场前，ANATEL 核准是法定前提。
target.zht: 強制：EMC 符合性構成 INMETRO 與 ABNT NBR IEC 62841 符合性評定的一部分，而任何含無線電模組的無繩工具投放巴西市場前，ANATEL 核准是法定前提。

cn.en: China domestic baseline uses GB EMC limits and SRRC radio approval; neither satisfies Brazilian INMETRO EMC or ANATEL homologation.
cn.zh: 中国国内基线采用 GB EMC 限值与 SRRC 无线电核准；二者均不满足巴西 INMETRO EMC 或 ANATEL 核准。
cn.zht: 中國國內基線採用 GB EMC 限值與 SRRC 無線電核准；二者均不滿足巴西 INMETRO EMC 或 ANATEL 核准。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Brazil-ready until EMC is covered inside the INMETRO and ABNT NBR IEC 62841 assessment and, for any embedded radio module, a valid ANATEL homologation with the required label is obtained; China GB EMC and SRRC evidence does not substitute.

rows.requirement: In-Country Importer, CNPJ, and Market-Access Logistics
rows.target_requirement: Brazil requires an in-country importer holding a valid CNPJ to act as the responsible economic operator, hold the INMETRO certification or registration, and handle customs clearance. Energy and efficiency labelling may apply through PBE and PROCEL, inland transport of goods and any dangerous-goods batteries is regulated by ANTT, and shipments typically enter via ports such as Santos or Paranaguá.
target_standards: In-country importer registered with a CNPJ as the responsible economic operator
INMETRO conformity certification or registration held by the importer for compulsory product families
PBE and PROCEL energy and efficiency labelling where applicable
ANTT regulation for inland and dangerous-goods transport
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese exporters often sell ex-works or FOB and treat the buyer as merely a distributor, relying on GB/T product documentation and a China business licence. Brazil instead places legal product responsibility on a local importer holding the CNPJ and the INMETRO certification, not on the Chinese manufacturer alone.
china_standards: China business licence and GB/T product documentation
Standard FOB or ex-works export arrangement without an appointed in-country responsible operator
rows.gap: Without an appointed importer holding a CNPJ and the INMETRO certification, the goods cannot be lawfully cleared or sold, regardless of factory quality. Chinese exporters must arrange the importer of record early, ensure the INMETRO certificate is held in Brazil, confirm any PBE and PROCEL labelling, and plan ANTT-compliant inland transport from Santos or Paranaguá.

target.en: Mandatory: an in-country importer with a CNPJ and the corresponding INMETRO certification or registration is a legal precondition for customs clearance and sale; PBE and PROCEL labelling and ANTT transport rules apply where relevant.
target.zh: 强制：持有 CNPJ 及相应 INMETRO 认证或登记的在地进口商是清关与销售的法定前提；PBE 与 PROCEL 标签及 ANTT 运输规则在相关情形下适用。
target.zht: 強制：持有 CNPJ 及相應 INMETRO 認證或登記的在地進口商是清關與銷售的法定前提；PBE 與 PROCEL 標籤及 ANTT 運輸規則在相關情形下適用。

cn.en: China domestic baseline relies on a China business licence and GB/T documentation, which does not establish a Brazilian responsible importer.
cn.zh: 中国国内基线依赖中国营业执照与 GB/T 文件，无法确立巴西的责任进口商。
cn.zht: 中國國內基線依賴中國營業執照與 GB/T 文件，無法確立巴西的責任進口商。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Brazil-ready until an in-country importer with a CNPJ holds the INMETRO certification or registration, with PBE and PROCEL labelling and ANTT transport addressed; a China business licence and GB/T file alone do not enable market access.

source.publisher: INMETRO (Instituto Nacional de Metrologia, Qualidade e Tecnologia)

rows.requirement: Noise Emission and the Absence of an Outdoor-Noise Directive
rows.target_requirement: Brazil does not have a direct equivalent of the EU outdoor-noise Directive 2000/14/EC, so there is no stand-alone guaranteed-sound-power marking or fixed noise label mandated for power tools at market entry. Noise is instead addressed through general consumer product-safety duties, any noise or vibration declaration clauses inside the applicable ABNT NBR IEC 62841 standard, and workplace and environmental noise rules that apply to use rather than to placing the product on the market.
target_standards: No Brazilian equivalent of EU Directive 2000/14/EC on outdoor equipment noise
Noise and vibration declaration clauses within the applicable ABNT NBR IEC 62841 standard where present
General consumer product-safety obligations (Brazilian Consumer Defence Code)
Workplace and environmental noise rules apply to use, not to market entry
rows.china_equivalent: China files typically include a noise and vibration emission declaration generated within GB/T 3883 series testing, but there is no China mark equivalent to an EU guaranteed-sound-power label either. The China baseline is therefore a test-report declaration rather than a separate noise conformity mark.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series noise and vibration declaration
No China equivalent of an EU guaranteed-sound-power noise mark
rows.gap: Because neither Brazil nor China imposes an EU-style outdoor-noise mark, the practical gap is honest and small: an exporter should ensure the noise and vibration declaration in the ABNT NBR IEC 62841 test report is complete and accurate, and not assume an EU noise label is needed for Brazil. The real attention point is correct user-information disclosure, not a separate Brazilian noise approval.

target.en: Not a stand-alone mandatory market-entry mark: Brazil has no outdoor-noise directive equivalent, so noise is covered indirectly through the ABNT NBR IEC 62841 declaration and general product-safety duties; workplace and environmental noise rules bind use rather than market entry.
target.zh: 非独立强制市场准入标志：巴西无户外噪声指令对应法规，故噪声经 ABNT NBR IEC 62841 声明与一般产品安全义务间接覆盖；工作场所与环境噪声规则约束使用环节，而非市场准入。
target.zht: 非獨立強制市場准入標誌：巴西無戶外噪聲指令對應法規，故噪聲經 ABNT NBR IEC 62841 聲明與一般產品安全義務間接覆蓋；工作場所與環境噪聲規則約束使用環節，而非市場准入。

cn.en: China baseline is a GB/T 3883 series noise and vibration declaration, with no separate noise conformity mark.
cn.zh: 中国基线为 GB/T 3883 系列噪声与振动声明，无独立噪声符合性标志。
cn.zht: 中國基線為 GB/T 3883 系列噪聲與振動聲明，無獨立噪聲符合性標誌。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No separate Brazilian outdoor-noise approval applies; the honest requirement is a complete and accurate noise and vibration declaration inside the ABNT NBR IEC 62841 documentation. Do not assume an EU 2000/14/EC noise label is needed for Brazil.

source.publisher: INMETRO (Instituto Nacional de Metrologia, Qualidade e Tecnologia)

rows.target_requirement: Brazil does not operate a single RoHS-style horizontal directive identical to the EU, so restricted-substance control for power tools is addressed through ABNT NBR product standards, INMETRO conformity requirements, electronics waste and chemical-control rules under the National Solid Waste Policy and IBAMA-administered controls, and importer due diligence. Material and substance evidence is expected to be available and consistent with the certified product.
target_standards: ABNT NBR product standards and INMETRO conformity requirements covering materials
National Solid Waste Policy (Lei 12.305/2010) for electronics waste and reverse logistics
IBAMA-administered chemical and hazardous-substance controls where applicable
Importer material due diligence consistent with the certified product
rows.china_equivalent: China files commonly use China RoHS marking and GB/T material evidence together with GB/T 3883 safety reports. This material evidence can support a Brazilian dossier but must be mapped onto Brazilian product-standard, waste-policy, and importer due-diligence expectations rather than treated as automatic acceptance.
china_standards: China RoHS marking and GB/T material declarations
rows.gap: The gap is that Brazil has no single identical RoHS directive, so an exporter cannot simply present an EU RoHS declaration and assume acceptance. Material evidence must be aligned with ABNT NBR product standards, the National Solid Waste Policy reverse-logistics duties, and any IBAMA chemical controls, with the importer maintaining traceability for the certified product.

target.en: Mandatory where applicable: material and waste obligations arise through INMETRO and ABNT NBR product requirements, the National Solid Waste Policy reverse-logistics duties, and IBAMA controls; there is no single horizontal RoHS mark to obtain.
target.zh: 在适用情形下强制：材料与废物义务经 INMETRO 与 ABNT NBR 产品要求、《国家固体废物政策》逆向物流义务及 IBAMA 管控产生；并无单一横向 RoHS 标志可取得。
target.zht: 在適用情形下強制：材料與廢物義務經 INMETRO 與 ABNT NBR 產品要求、《國家固體廢物政策》逆向物流義務及 IBAMA 管控產生；並無單一橫向 RoHS 標誌可取得。

cn.en: China baseline uses China RoHS marking and GB/T material evidence, which does not automatically satisfy Brazilian product-standard, waste-policy, and due-diligence expectations.
cn.zh: 中国基线采用中国 RoHS 标识与 GB/T 材料证据，不会自动满足巴西产品标准、废物政策与尽职调查要求。
cn.zht: 中國基線採用中國 RoHS 標識與 GB/T 材料證據，不會自動滿足巴西產品標準、廢物政策與盡職調查要求。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Brazil-ready until material and substance evidence is aligned with ABNT NBR product standards, the National Solid Waste Policy reverse-logistics duties, and any IBAMA controls; an EU RoHS declaration alone does not establish Brazilian acceptance.

source.publisher: Ministério do Meio Ambiente / Government of Brazil

rows.target_requirement: Cordless power-tool battery packs in Brazil are addressed through INMETRO certification requirements applicable to portable batteries, CONAMA and National Solid Waste Policy rules on battery disposal and reverse logistics, and dangerous-goods transport rules under ANTT for lithium batteries. There is no Brazilian copy of the EU Battery Regulation, so obligations are distributed across certification, environmental, and transport regimes rather than one single battery regulation.
target_standards: INMETRO certification requirements applicable to portable batteries where listed
CONAMA resolutions and National Solid Waste Policy (Lei 12.305/2010) battery reverse-logistics and disposal rules
ANTT dangerous-goods transport rules for lithium batteries
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, with separate GB lithium-battery safety and UN transport evidence. Brazilian obligations attach to the battery placed on the market and to its end-of-life reverse logistics, which the China baseline does not fully cover.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series with the battery pack tested as a tool accessory
GB lithium battery safety and UN transport evidence where applicable
rows.gap: A cordless tool needs the battery addressed beyond the tool safety test: any applicable INMETRO portable-battery requirement, CONAMA and National Solid Waste Policy reverse-logistics enrolment for battery collection and disposal, and ANTT-compliant lithium transport. A pack that passes China domestic and UN transport tests may still lack the Brazilian reverse-logistics and certification coverage.

target.en: Mandatory where applicable: portable-battery INMETRO requirements where listed, CONAMA and National Solid Waste Policy reverse-logistics duties, and ANTT lithium transport rules apply; these are distributed obligations, not a single EU-style battery regulation.
target.zh: 在适用情形下强制：列入时的便携式电池 INMETRO 要求、CONAMA 与《国家固体废物政策》逆向物流义务及 ANTT 锂电池运输规则适用；这是分布式义务，而非单一欧盟式电池法规。
target.zht: 在適用情形下強制：列入時的便攜式電池 INMETRO 要求、CONAMA 與《國家固體廢物政策》逆向物流義務及 ANTT 鋰電池運輸規則適用；這是分布式義務，而非單一歐盟式電池法規。

cn.en: China tool and battery evidence under GB/T 3883 and GB lithium standards does not automatically satisfy Brazilian battery certification, reverse-logistics, and transport duties.
cn.zh: GB/T 3883 与 GB 锂电池标准下的中国工具与电池证据，不会自动满足巴西电池认证、逆向物流与运输义务。
cn.zht: GB/T 3883 與 GB 鋰電池標準下的中國工具與電池證據，不會自動滿足巴西電池認證、逆向物流與運輸義務。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Brazil-ready for cordless tools until the battery is checked against any applicable INMETRO portable-battery requirement, enrolled in CONAMA and National Solid Waste Policy reverse logistics, and shipped under ANTT lithium-transport rules; China GB/T and UN-transport evidence alone is insufficient.

source.publisher: INMETRO (Instituto Nacional de Metrologia, Qualidade e Tecnologia)
